description: This file contains unit tests for the RuntimeLocator component in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing node runtime resolution and version parsing.

classes.name: RuntimeLocatorTests
classes.description: A struct containing tests for the RuntimeLocator's ability to resolve Node runtimes and parse versions.

methods.name: makeTempExecutable
methods.description: Creates a temporary executable file with specified contents and returns its URL.

methods.name: resolve succeeds with valid node
methods.description: Tests that RuntimeLocator.resolve correctly resolves a valid node executable with a valid version string.

methods.name: resolve fails on boundary below minimum
methods.description: Tests that RuntimeLocator.resolve correctly fails when the node version is below the minimum supported version.

methods.name: resolve fails when too old
methods.description: Tests resolution failure when the node version is too old.

methods.name: resolve fails when version unparsable
methods.description: Tests resolution failure when the node version cannot be parsed.

methods.name: describe failure includes paths
methods.description: Verifies that the failure message includes search paths information.

methods.name: runtime version parses with leading V and metadata
methods.description: Checks that RuntimeVersion.from correctly parses version strings with leading 'v' and additional metadata.
